scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Phew, those young people nowadays, are so rude and have no manners.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
唉，現在的年輕人，真是沒大沒小，毫無禮貌。

scripts.text: Ignore him
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text: Talk with him
scripts.translation: 與他交談

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
You, very bad young man!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
你，真是沒教養的年輕人！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sir, are you alright??
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先生，您沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
....?? You are not like other young people. You have good manners! You know what happened to me..?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
...？你倒跟其他年輕人不一樣，挺有禮貌！
你知道我剛才碰上什麼事了嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
I was on the way to visit my son who lives in Rune-Midgarts. It's really far away, so I took the airplane, and..
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我想去盧恩·米德加茲看兒子，他住得可遠了，就搭了飛空艇，誰知道...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
those young people...so noisy.... I was standing but none of them offered me a seat..and they were just talking loudly which bothered everyone.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
那些年輕人...太吵了...我站著，卻沒有人給我讓座...而且他們大聲喧譁，打擾了所有人。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
I could lecture them if I were 10 years younger..
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
如果我年輕十歲，我就能好好教訓他們了...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Pffff.. Never liked the passing of time....
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
唉...真不願意服老啊...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
So, you... what would you do??
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
那麼，你...你會怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
In an open, public place, you are supposed to stay quiet to the destination and offer your seat to the elderly and the infirm.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
在公共交通工具上，就該安安靜靜地坐到站，遇見老弱還要主動讓座。

[Weird old man]

scripts.translation:

如果我年輕十歲，我就能好好教訓他們了...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Pffff.. Never liked the passing of time....
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
唉...真不願意服老啊...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
So, you... what would you do??
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
那麼，你...你會怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
In an open, public place, you are supposed to stay quiet to the destination and offer your seat to the elderly and the infirm. Right?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
在公共交通工具上，就該安安靜靜地坐到站，遇見老弱還要主動讓座，對不對？

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Isn't that right?!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
難道不是嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Oh, and then you know what...?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
哦，對了，還有一件事...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Once I was walking in the town and some boys were spitting on the street and were bothering girls who were passing by...tut tut!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
有一次我在鎮上散步，看到一些男孩在街上吐口水，還騷擾路過的姑娘...嘖嘖！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
The world is going to the dogs.. How will it be?? It was even day time when they were doing it..tut tut.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
真是世風日下...以後可怎麼辦？
大白天就敢幹這種事...嘖嘖。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Oh, and then you know what...?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
哦，對了，還有一件事...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Oh, and then you know what...?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
哦，對了，還有一件事...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Lately young people are not so patient!!!!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
現在的年輕人，真是一點耐心都沒有！！！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
So often they say they will quit.. they say they can't do more. How will they live life with that kind of mentality..tut tut.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
動不動就說不幹了...說自己撐不下去。
這種心態，以後的日子怎麼過...嘖嘖。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
It's not easy to find a job. It is very difficult to be hired but then they even cannot stand a week there and leave the work place.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
找工作多不容易，好不容易被錄用了，連一週都待不住就走了。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
How impatient and irresponsible!!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
真是既沒耐心又沒責任感！！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Oh, and then you know what...?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
哦，對了，還有一件事...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Oh, and then you know what...?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
哦，對了，還有一件事...

scripts.text: ^E7A43DThe old man talked over and over again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^E7A43D那個老人一直在喋喋不休地說著。^000000

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Hm......You are not like common young people, you seem pretty patient too. I like that!!!
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
嗯...你和一般的年輕人不一樣，還挺有耐心。
老頭子我很欣賞！！！

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
Now I am just an weak old man but when I was young I was a famous merchant in the town.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我現在只是個虛弱的老人，但年輕時我可是鎮上著名的商人。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
It's been a while since I stopped the business,
but a former client of mine contacted me and asked me
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
我歇業有段日子了，前些時候，有個老客戶找到我，想請我幫個忙...

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
If I could get him some unknown objects named 'Will of Warrior', 'Thirst for Blood', and 'Chill of the Dead'.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
能不能幫他弄到一些名為“勇士的意志”、“血的飢渴”和“亡者之寒”的神秘物品。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
I like your politeness which most young people don't have, so if you get me those, I will give you some stuff that I consider as my treasure.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
像你這樣有禮貌的年輕人可不多見，我很欣賞。
替我找來那些東西，我就拿珍藏多年的寶貝跟你換。

scripts.text: When I gather them, I will come back
scripts.translation: 等我收集齊了，我會回來的

scripts.text: Show me the armors
scripts.translation: 給我看看防具

scripts.text: Show me the weapons
scripts.translation: 給我看看武器

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
OK, young man. See you later.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
好的，年輕人。回頭見。

scripts.text:
[Weird old man]
So, you are interested in armors.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]
那麼，你對防具感興趣。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[奇怪的老人]

scripts.text: ^FF0000 Check up your inventory. You got too many items to carry out the quest. ^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000 請檢查您的物品欄。您攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。^000000

scripts.text: Umba umba humbaa
scripts.translation: 翁巴翁巴翁巴

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Which are the equipments found so far?
scripts.translation: 目前發現了哪些裝備？

scripts.text: Here you are, sir.
scripts.translation: 給您，先生

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Hey, excuse me, but I'm not from Umbala! You are so rude.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
喂，打擾一下，我不是汶巴拉人！你太沒禮貌了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
As you can see I'm a training Sorcerer, and my name is Pudding.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如你所見，我是一名見習妖術師，我的名字叫布丁。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
... What's that face? I'm starting to feel unpleasant..
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
...你那是什麼表情？我可有點不高興了...

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
A couple of days ago while I was undergoing discipline, I felt a strange, bizarre tinge. So I followed that and it brought me here.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
前幾天修煉時，我感受到了一股古怪的氣息，就一路追到了這裡。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
OK, let me continue. I become bothered if you disturb me while I'm talking.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
好了，我接著說。
我最討厭別人打斷我說話。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
And I entered to the laboratory here in order to investigate and oh gosh! I found those monsters which were like doppelgangers from 'Geffen Dungeon'. It was full of them.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
我進實驗室調查了一下，結果，天哪！
裡面到處都是魔物，看著就像吉芬地下城里的死靈。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
From those monsters, I could find rare items like '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000', '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', and '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000' which you cannot find in any other place.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
從那些魔物身上，我找到了像“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”、“^952420血的飢渴^000000”和“^88C6F7亡者之寒^000000”這樣的稀有物品，你在其他地方是找不到的。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
And after many hours of research on my own, I finally figured out a way to use those items. Do you wanna know?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
經過好幾個小時的獨自研究，我終於想出了使用這些物品的方法。你想知道嗎？

scripts.text: Oh....pardon?!
Of course, I really wanna know.
scripts.translation: 當然，我真的很想知道

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Oh my! You fell asleep after you asked me something? Well, anyway I feel lazy to explain again so I will just continue.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
天哪！你問完問題就睡著了？好吧，反正我懶得再解釋一遍，我就繼續說了。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Good, I am content that you are listening to my story carefully. Then I will keep explaining.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
很好，我很滿意你在認真聽我講故事。那我繼續解釋。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Those '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' and '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000'..... are aggressive but warm materials.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”和“^952420血的飢渴^000000”...都是氣息溫熱、力量狂暴的材料。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
So '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' can dwell a special power to the 4th slot of an equipment,
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”能為裝備的第4個插槽賦予特殊力量...

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
and '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' can dwell a special power to the 3rd slot.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
而“^952420血的飢渴^000000”可以將特殊能力賦予第3個插槽。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Whereas!!!
'^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000' is a cold type material
which allows the return of power from '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000' so makes the equipment no longer enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
而“^88C6F7亡者之寒^000000”則是一種冰冷的材料！！！
它能消除“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或“^952420血的飢渴^000000”賦予的力量，移除裝備上的附魔。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
What do you say? Doesn't it sound interesting? But, there's a problem...
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
你覺得怎麼樣？聽起來很有趣吧？不過，有個問題...

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Since those materials can only be found from the monsters in the Lab., the special power also can be dwelt into certain equipments which can be obtained from the Lab.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
這些材料只能從實驗室的魔物身上獲得，它們的力量也只能賦予實驗室裡出產的特定裝備。

scripts.text: So what's the conclusion?
scripts.translation: 那麼結論是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
Gee.. I told you not to cut while I talk, didn't I? Well, I will answer that because that's important.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
嘖...不是說了，別打斷我嗎？
算了，這個問題很重要，我就回答一下。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
If you bring me 10 '^F2766EWill of Warrior^000000' or 10 '^952420Thirst for Blood^000000', I will dwell some power to certain equipments that you can find in the Lab..
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如果你給我10個“^F2766E勇士的意志^000000”或10個“^952420血的飢渴^000000”，我會將某種能力賦予你在實驗室中找到的特定裝備。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
And if you are not satisfied with the power you got, bring me 10 '^88C6F7Chill of the Dead^000000', and I will take off that power.
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
如果你不滿意獲得的能力，就給我10個“^88C6F7亡者之寒^000000”，我會移除那個能力。

scripts.text:
[Pudding]
What do you say? Having both options.....quite nice, huh?
scripts.translation:
[布丁]
